newsitem.title: DUBAI: Pakistan's Leghari arrives in Saudi for pilgrimage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Leghari arrives in Saudi for pilgrimage.

text.p: Pakistani President Farooq Leghari arrived in the western Saudi city of Medina on Thursday to perform a pilgrimage in the nearby holy city of Mecca, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said.

The agency said Leghari will perform the Umra, a minor pilgrimage which can take place at any time of the year and takes just over an hour to complete. SPA gave no other details on his visit to the kingdom.
Pakistani Prime Minister-elect Nawaz Sharif left for a short pilgrimage to Mecca on Wednesday.
